gaps.explanation: Proprietary funds statement of receipts, disbursements and changes in net position - cash basis (p6) prints Water, Sewer and Ambulance columns; no business-type lines in detail[]. Statement receipts[] = Charges for Services + Miscellaneous Receipts + Interest Income + Federal Grant. Water: 207,329 + 1,179 + 1,795 = 210,303; Sewer: 82,930 + 1,659 + 1,152 = 85,741; Ambulance: 26,477 + 271 = 26,748. 210,303 + 85,741 + 26,748 = 322,792 = statement total.

gaps.explanation: Same statement (p6). Statement disbursements[] = Total Operating Disbursements 312,361 + Bond Principal 120,000 + Bond Interest 18,982 = 451,343. Water 112,855 (50,282 + 5,525 + 37,293 + 2,637 + 8,371 + 510 + 728 + 3,631 + 3,878) + 120,000 + 18,982 = 251,837; Sewer 183,780 (42,132 + 2,409 + 25,107 + 2,741 + 12,472 + 2,971 + 95,948); Ambulance 15,726 (785 + 3,390 + 725 + 2,110 + 3,518 + 5,104 + 94). 251,837 + 183,780 + 15,726 = 451,343 = statement total. Capital Outlay is printed without a function; labelled by single-purpose fund (Water/Sewer utilities, Ambulance public safety), category capital outlay as on the statement line.
